title: The Resume Example Database — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Real information from reliable public sources and official catalogs, fact-checked reference. Role-specific resume examples and formatting guidance. The Resume Example Database provides annotated resume examples by role and experience level: what each section should contain, how to phrase achievements with numbers, and formatting rules that keep resumes readable by applicant-tracking systems. Examples use fictional candidates so no real person's data appears. The Signature side adds bullet rewriters that turn duties into measured achievements.
capabilities: Provide annotated resume examples by role and level
Teach achievement phrasing with quantified results
Document applicant-tracking-system formatting rules
Offer section-by-section content guidance
Rewrite duty bullets into achievement bullets
